request: Build a small jumping game in this empty project. A dynamic sphere named `Ball` (radius 0.5) starts above a fixed floor named `Floor` whose top is at y = 0 and falls onto it under gravity. An input action `jump` (key Space) sets the ball's upward velocity to 5 m/s, but only while the ball rests on the floor; a press in mid-air changes nothing. A counter named `jumps` starts at 0 and adds 1 for each jump.
